spec.rationale: Types the owner-earnings leg of the component prose falsifier for a prospective Q3 FY2026 TTM observation. The low-case reinvestment DCF grows from normalized owner earnings of 75.081 USD millions (FY2025 operating cash flow 211.339 minus capital spending 136.258 per AXON/research/evidence/sec_companyfacts.json and the low-case calculation proof). If trailing-four-quarter normalized owner earnings at 2026-09-30 falls below that anchor, cash conversion is worse than the low-case bridge assumes and the low-case per-share value turns negative. Incremental-return and reinvestment-runway legs remain judgment-only and are not typed. Q3 FY2026 10-Q is not filed as of the information cutoff; historical replay on Q2 FY2026 TTM validates the sec_companyfacts_ttm adapter.
